findings.title: OS Command Injection via Environment Variables
findings.trigger: An attacker can inject malicious commands into the 'url' parameter that manipulate environment variables.
findings.assumptions: The 'url' parameter is attacker-controlled and can contain arbitrary input, and the environment variables are not properly sanitized.

findings.title: OS Command Injection via Shell Metacharacters
findings.trigger: An attacker can inject shell metacharacters into the 'url' parameter to execute arbitrary commands.
findings.assumptions: The 'url' parameter is attacker-controlled and can contain arbitrary input, and the shell is not properly sanitized.
